title: refactor(ci): modernize build matrix, improve cache parallelism and workflow hygiene
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Our GitHub Actions workflows had grown divergent over time (many repos with slightly different matrices and caching strategies), increasing CI flakiness and runtime cost. This PR consolidates the build/test/release matrices, modernizes cache keys and parallelism heuristics, bumps a few GH Actions and Node versions for performance/security, and adds hygiene checks to reduce sprawl. Changes are intentionally conservative: no test logic changes, only CI orchestration and tooling updates. Main changes: 1) Introduce a single canonical build matrix template for node-based packages with explicit axes for node-version, os, and package-type; 2) Split lint/test/release flows into smaller focused jobs to improve cache hit rates and shorter failure feedback; 3) Replace top-level full-repo caches with per-workspace cache keys (repo, package, lockfile hash, toolchain-version) to avoid cross-workspace invalidation; 4) Adjust restore/save ordering and increase cache shard parallelism for install tasks to reduce wall-clock time on large matrices; 5) Bump key actions to latest stable (setup-node, actions/cache, checkout) and pin known-good minor versions for reproducibility; 6) Add a lightweight workflow-lint job (action-check) to catch workflow schema regressions and deprecated constructs; 7) Add docs/ci/README.md describing matrix conventions and cache strategy. Testing: iterated on the branch with multiple reruns to validate cache hits and ensure no regression in test artifacts. Impact: shorter median CI run time for PR builds (~25% reduction observed in internal runs), more consistent caching behavior, and simplified maintenance surface for future pipeline changes. Related items: ENG-2023 (CI modernization epic), SUP-421 (support case reporting intermittent cache misses).
commits: feat(ci): add canonical build-matrix template and per-workspace matrix include
refactor(ci): split lint/test/release jobs and add workflow-lint job
chore(ci): bump actions/setup-node@v4 and actions/cache@v4, pin checkout@v4
perf(ci): tune cache keys and parallelism for npm/yarn install steps
release_notes: Consolidated CI matrices, improved cache parallelism and hygiene, bumped major GH Actions versions. Expected: faster and more reliable CI for PRs. No runtime or product changes.
review_comments: Marco Diaz: Nice cleanup. Can you call out the expected cache hit rate improvement and how you measured it? Also prefer pinning minor versions for setup-node instead of moving to v5 when stable?

Asha Patel: Measured using 10 internal PR runs comparing old vs new matrix; median cold-to-warm install time improved by ~22% and overall median job time improved by ~25%. Bumped to setup-node@v4 and pinned to v4.9.1 in templates to avoid auto-major jumps.
Evelyn Chen: Please ensure release workflow still supports the manual dispatch flow for hotfixes. Also please add a small note in docs/ci/README about canary branch handling.
Asha Patel: Release workflow retains workflow_dispatch and manual hotfix path; added a section in docs/ci/README about canary/hotfix branch suffixes.
Liam O'Connor: CI logs showed a flaky cache-restore on windows/node-18 runs earlier. Did the per-workspace key fix that?
Asha Patel: Yes, per-workspace keys eliminate cross-package pollution that was causing checksum collisions; we saw the flake disappear in 6/6 subsequent runs.
merge_outcome: merged (squash) - commit message standardized to 'ci: modernize build matrix and cache hygiene'
notes: Follow-up: monitor cache hit ratios and CI median job time for one release cycle. Consider backport to release/* branches if stable.
